title: J001: Build Go mock Central API server with fixture endpoints and call counters
description:
**Size:** 🏗️ large
**Category:** testing
**Priority:** critical
**Source:** Proposed for 'After binary builds, Docker image builds, etc. are now in place'

Create a standalone Go mock server at test/e2e/mockapi/ using net/http (no frameworks). Implements 7 endpoints: GET /v1/ping (health), POST /v1/register (returns fixture node_id, mesh_ip, peers), POST /v1/nodes/{id}/heartbeat (returns reconcile:true), GET /v1/nodes/{id}/state (returns fixture peers, policies), GET /v1/nodes/{id}/metadata (returns fixture metadata blob), GET /v1/nodes/{id}/events (SSE stream with keep-alive), and GET /test/assertions (returns JSON call counters). Uses atomic counters for registration, heartbeat, metadata, and state calls. Includes a Dockerfile for the mock server. Fixture response shapes must match plexd's actual API client types found in internal/ packages. Add unit tests for the mock server verifying each endpoint returns correct fixtures and counters increment properly.

**Rationale:** This is the foundation for all three E2E test jobs. Without a mock Central API, plexd cannot execute its real registration, heartbeat, metadata fetch, and reconciliation flows in CI. Currently there is zero validation that plexd actually works against a running API server.

**Affected Areas:**
- test/e2e/mockapi/main.go
- test/e2e/mockapi/Dockerfile
- test/e2e/mockapi/main_test.go
- internal/
elaboration:
**Size:** 🏗️ large **Category:** infrastructure **Priority:** high ## Open Questions No remaining open questions — the user has resolved all ambiguities: - **Mock API scope:** Read-only stubs returning fixture data - **Trigger strategy:** Path-filtered triggers ## Summary Add end-to-end test workflows in GitHub Actions that validate plexd's Docker image, Kubernetes DaemonSet deployment, and systemd service installation against a fully simulated Plexsphere Central API. A lightweight Go mock server implementing the critical API endpoints (`/v1/register`, `/v1/nodes/{id}/heartbeat`, `/v1/nodes/{id}/state`, `/v1/nodes/{id}/metadata`, SSE `/v1/nodes/{id}/events`) runs as the test backend, allowing plexd to execute its real registration, heartbeat, metadata fetch, and reconciliation flows in each deployment mode. ## Scope **Included:** - Go mock server binary (`net/http`, no frameworks) implementing: `/v1/ping`, `/v1/register`, `/v1/nodes/{id}/heartbeat`, `/v1/nodes/{id}/state`, `/v1/nodes/{id}/metadata`, `/v1/nodes/{id}/events` (SSE), plus `/test/assertions` for programmatic verification — all read-only stubs returning fixture data with in-memory call counters - **Docker E2E job** — build image, start mock API + plexd container via compose, verify registration + heartbeat + metadata fetch - **Kubernetes E2E job** — `kind` cluster, apply all `deploy/kubernetes/` manifests (namespace, RBAC, CRDs, serviceaccount, secret, configmap, DaemonSet), verify DaemonSet pod readiness + plexd registers and heartbeats against mock API - **systemd E2E job** — systemd-in-Docker container, install plexd binary + `deploy/systemd/plexd.service` unit file, start service, verify registration + heartbeat + metadata fetch - Makefile targets: `test-e2e-docker`, `test-e2e-k8s`, `test-e2e-systemd` for local execution **Excluded (YAGNI):** - Full 18-endpoint mock — only core lifecycle + metadata endpoints; rest is unit-tested - WireGuard mesh validation — requires `NET_ADMIN` + kernel module; infeasible on GHA runners - Performance/load testing — separate concern - Multi-arch E2E (arm64) — GHA arm64 runners are slow/limited; amd64 validates deployment patterns - Cloud-init E2E — requires VM provisioning; too heavy for CI - Helm chart — none exists in the project - Docker image push to registry — handled by release workflow ## Visualization ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph GHA["GitHub Actions - e2e.yml"] direction TB trigger["Push / PR trigger

test/e2e/, Dockerfile, workflows"] subgraph docker_e2e["Docker E2E Job"] d1["Build plexd image"] d2["Build mock-api image"] d3["docker compose up"] d4["Wait for registration"] d5["Assert heartbeat + metadata"] d6["Tear down"] d1 --> d3 d2 --> d3 d3 --> d4 --> d5 --> d6 end subgraph k8s_e2e["Kubernetes E2E Job"] k1["Create kind cluster"] k2["Load plexd + mock-api images"] k3["Apply deploy/kubernetes/ manifests"] k4["Deploy mock-api as Service"] k5["Wait DaemonSet ready"] k6["Verify via /test/assertions"] k7["Delete kind cluster"] k1 --> k2 --> k3 --> k4 --> k5 --> k6 --> k7 end subgraph systemd_e2e["systemd E2E Job"] s1["Start systemd container"] s2["Start mock-api container"] s3["Install plexd binary + unit file"] s4["systemctl start plexd"] s5["Verify registration + heartbeat + metadata"] s6["systemctl stop plexd"] s1 --> s3 s2 --> s3 s3 --> s4 --> s5 --> s6 end trigger --> docker_e2e trigger --> k8s_e2e trigger --> systemd_e2e end ``` ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant plexd as plexd agent participant mock as Mock Central API participant verify as Test Verifier plexd->>mock: GET /v1/ping mock-->>plexd: 200 OK plexd->>mock: POST /v1/register mock-->>plexd: 200 {node_id, mesh_ip, peers} plexd->>mock: POST /v1/nodes/{id}/heartbeat mock-->>plexd: 200 {reconcile: true} plexd->>mock: GET /v1/nodes/{id}/state mock-->>plexd: 200 {peers, policies} plexd->>mock: GET /v1/nodes/{id}/metadata mock-->>plexd: 200 {metadata blob} verify->>mock: GET /test/assertions mock-->>verify: {reg_count, hb_count, meta_count} ``` ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph mock_server["Mock API Server - test/e2e/mockapi"] ping["/v1/ping"] reg["/v1/register"] hb["/v1/nodes/{id}/heartbeat"] st["/v1/nodes/{id}/state"] meta["/v1/nodes/{id}/metadata"] events["/v1/nodes/{id}/events SSE"] assert["/test/assertions"] end subgraph counters["In-Memory Counters"] rc["Registration count"] hc["Heartbeat count"] mc["Metadata fetch count"] sc["State fetch count"] end reg --> rc hb --> hc meta --> mc st --> sc assert --> counters ``` ## Key Components - **`test/e2e/mockapi/`** — Go mock server binary (`main.go` + `Dockerfile`). Implements 7 endpoints with read-only fixture responses. Tracks call counts in-memory via atomic counters. Exposes `/test/assertions` returning JSON `{registration_count, heartbeat_count, metadata_fetch_count, state_fetch_count, last_heartbeat_at}`. - **`test/e2e/docker-compose.yml`** — Compose file with `mock-api` and `plexd` services on shared bridge network. Mock API starts first (healthcheck on `/v1/ping`), plexd configured via `PLEXD_API_URL` env var. - **`test/e2e/docker/`** — Docker E2E test script: starts compose, polls `/test/assertions` with timeout, asserts `registration_count >= 1`, `heartbeat_count >= 1`, `metadata_fetch_count >= 1`. Exits non-zero on failure. - **`test/e2e/kubernetes/`** — K8s E2E test script + mock-api Kubernetes manifests (Deployment + ClusterIP Service). Uses `kind create cluster`, loads locally-built images, applies `deploy/kubernetes/` manifests + mock-api manifests, waits for DaemonSet rollout, port-forwards to mock-api, validates assertions. - **`test/e2e/systemd/`** — systemd E2E test script + systemd-enabled Dockerfile. Copies plexd binary + `deploy/systemd/plexd.service` into container, configures `PLEXD_API_URL` via environment drop-in, starts service via `systemctl`, validates against mock-api on same Docker network. - **`.github/workflows/e2e.yml`** — Single workflow with three parallel jobs (`docker-e2e`, `kubernetes-e2e`, `systemd-e2e`). Path-filtered on `cmd/`, `internal/`, `deploy/`, `test/e2e/`, `Dockerfile`, and workflow files. Runs on `ubuntu-latest`. Uploads logs as artifacts on failure. - **`Makefile` additions** — Three targets: `test-e2e-docker`, `test-e2e-k8s`, `test-e2e-systemd`. Each self-contained with build + run + teardown.
